text: With squared radius s≥0 and I6(s)=2i∫₁∞ φ0(it)exp(−πst)dt, there is one C>0 independent of s such that for every s≥0, ‖I6(s)‖≤∫₁∞ C exp(−2πt)exp(−πst)dt. This pairs only the uniform integral estimate in the proof, not the full Schwartz proposition.
